DISEASE WATCH - Aparri
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Aparri: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.
Apply split fertilizer doses when field conditions improve.
Keep fertilizer stocks dry and elevated.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Aparri: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Aparri
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.
texts.facebook:

Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

adaptation_measures: Defer pesticide or foliar spraying during rain, strong wind, or very high humidity.
Resume only during calm, dry windows and follow label safety intervals.

adaptation_measures: Avoid strenuous field operations during peak heat hours.
Monitor flowering/tasseling crops for heat stress and maintain soil moisture.
Use heat-tolerant varieties in future planting where locally suitable.

texts.bulletin: HIGH HEAT STRESS — Lasam: Avoid prolonged field work from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Ensure adequate hydration for farm workers. Monitor heat-sensitive crops (vegetables, high-value crops). Reschedule spraying and transplanting to early morning hours. Check livestock ventilation and water supply.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: High heat in Lasam. Avoid farm work 10AM-2PM. Stay hydrated.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS ADVISORY — Lasam
High heat conditions: schedule farm work early morning or late afternoon.
texts.facebook: ☀️ HEAT ADVISORY — Lasam: High heat conditions. Avoid fieldwork 10AM–2PM. #DARFOCagayanValley #HeatStress

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Lasam: 3 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Lasam. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Lasam
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Lasam: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

adaptation_measures: Defer fertilizer application before heavy rain to prevent nutrient loss and runoff.
Apply split fertilizer doses when field conditions improve.
Keep fertilizer stocks dry and elevated.

texts.bulletin: FERTILIZER APPLICATION ADVISORY — Lasam: Current rainfall conditions increase risk of nutrient loss through leaching and runoff. DEFER basal and top-dress fertilizer application until 2–3 dry days are observed. Consider split-application strategy when conditions improve. For critical growth stages, consult AEW/MAO before proceeding.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not apply fertilizer today due to rain risk. Wait 2-3 dry days. Less waste, better yield.
texts.lgu:
AGRI-OPERATIONS ADVISORY — Lasam
Advise farmers to postpone fertilizer application. Rain will reduce fertilizer efficacy and increase runoff to waterways.
texts.facebook:
🌱 FERTILIZER REMINDER — Lasam:
Hindi magandang maglagay ng pataba ngayon dahil may ulan. Maghintay ng 2–3 araw na tuyo para mas epektibo ang pataba. #PatubaAdvice #DARFOCagayanValley

adaptation_measures: Defer pesticide or foliar spraying during rain, strong wind, or very high humidity.
Resume only during calm, dry windows and follow label safety intervals.
Strengthen pest scouting and non-chemical IPM while spraying is delayed.

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Lasam: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions. Rain within 4–6 hours of application will wash off chemicals, reducing efficacy and increasing environmental contamination risk. Reschedule spraying to early morning hours on clear days.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.
texts.lgu: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Lasam: Rainfall expected. Advise farmers to defer all pesticide and foliar spraying.
texts.facebook: 🚫 SPRAYING ADVISORY — Lasam: Huwag mag-spray ng pesticide habang may ulan. Mag-schedule sa maliwanag na umaga. #PestControl #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Piat: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
texts.sms: DA HEAT ALERT: Dangerous heat in Piat. NO farm work 9AM-4PM. Drink water. Protect livestock.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Piat
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.

🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

#HeatStress #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Cabagan due to rainfall of 32.5 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Cabagan. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.

3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Mahatao
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Mahatao: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

adaptation_measures: Defer pesticide or foliar spraying during rain, strong wind, or very high humidity.
Resume only during calm, dry windows and follow label safety intervals.
Strengthen pest scouting and non-chemical IPM while spraying is delayed.

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Mahatao: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions. Rain within 4–6 hours of application will wash off chemicals, reducing efficacy and increasing environmental contamination risk. Reschedule spraying to early morning hours on clear days.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.
texts.lgu: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Mahatao: Rainfall expected. Advise farmers to defer all pesticide and foliar spraying.
texts.facebook: 🚫 SPRAYING ADVISORY — Mahatao: Huwag mag-spray ng pesticide habang may ulan. Mag-schedule sa maliwanag na umaga. #PestControl #DARFOCagayanValley

decision_support.immediate_farmer_action: DA WARNING: Drying risk in Mahatao. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.
decision_support.lgu_da_action:
POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Mahatao
Coordinate mobile dryers, tarpaulins, and storage support for farmers harvesting rice/corn.
decision_support.public_advisory: POSTHARVEST ADVISORY - Mahatao: High drying risk. Use mechanical dryers or covered storage to protect palay/mais quality.
decision_support.sms_ready: DA WARNING: Drying risk in Mahatao. Use mechanical dryer/covered storage; avoid wet grain spoilage.
decision_support.when_to_recheck: Re-check after the next 6:00 AM PHT pipeline run, and immediately when PAGASA issues or updates warnings.

adaptation_measures: Use mechanical dryers, covered drying floors, tarpaulins, and ventilated temporary storage.
Prioritize hauling of wet palay/corn to postharvest facilities to avoid quality losses.
Monitor grain moisture before storage and milling.

priority_municipalities.lgu_da_action:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Piat
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.
